items.title: AXT's Supply Agreements Expand: Can They Strengthen Revenue Growth?
items.summary: AXTI's expanding InP supply agreements, backed by customer deposits and commitments through 2031, improve shipment visibility and could support revenue growth.

items.title: Marvell Jumps Ahead of Key Earnings as AI Stocks Rally After Nvidia's Results
items.summary: The artificial-intelligence trade roared back to life on Thursday after Nvidia's medium-term guidance signaled that demand for chips should remain robust next year. Shares of Marvell Technology jumped 4% in premarket trading.

items.title: US Stock Market Today: S&P 500 Futures Slip As Traders Watch PCE And Fed
items.summary: The Morning Bull - US Market Morning Update Thursday, Aug, 27 2026 US market stock futures are mixed in early trade, with S&P 500 contracts slightly softer while Dow futures edge higher. The big focus is on US PCE inflation data and speeches at the Jackson Hole gathering, which together act as a key scorecard for where interest rates might head next. At the same time, oil prices are easing and US crude inventories rose by 4.2 million barrels, which can take some pressure off fuel costs for...

items.title: Energy, Industrials, and Utilities Are Leading the Stock Market
items.summary: With the market in a holding pattern ahead of Nvidia’s earnings report, industrials, energy, and utilities were doing the heavy lifting. The Dow Jones Industrial Average dropped 156 points, or 0.3%. The S&P 500 was down 0.

items.title: Lumentum Climbs 4% as the AI Optics Trade Extends a Second Session, Coherent and Applied Optoelectronics Drift
items.summary: Lumentum is surging for a second straight session with no fresh catalyst behind the move, while its closest peers drift sideways or lower. That divergence between one red-hot stock and a quiet sector tells investors something important about where this rally actually stands.

items.title: Wall Street Just Invented the ‘Neocloud’ ETF. It Owns the Companies Renting AI Compute to Everyone Else
items.summary: A new ETF launched this August targets the companies renting AI compute directly to hyperscalers, offering something QQQ never could: pure-play exposure to contracted infrastructure backlogs worth hundreds of billions. The tradeoffs, however, are not small.

items.title: AAOI Benefits From Strong 800G Demand: Can It Beat LITE & COHR?
items.summary: Applied Optoelectronics 800G revenues surge more than tenfold year over year as demand outpaces supply and capacity expansion targets further growth through mid-2027.

items.title: Lumentum's 1.6T & 200G Ramp Faces Cisco & NVIDIA Competition
items.summary: LITE's 1.6T transceiver and 200G laser ramps support AI connectivity growth as capacity expands amid tight supply and tougher competition.
